trip.title: Baltimore → Portland, Maine
trip.subtitle: A long-weekend eating tour of the Old Port — oysters, lighthouses, cozy cafés
trip.notes: Roundtrip BWI⇄PWM, nonstop (out Sat 10:55a–12:25p, back Wed 12:45p–2:25p). Carry-on only. CAR-FREE: walk the Old Port, rideshare only for the airport and the Cape Elizabeth lighthouse. Short daylight — sunset ~4:30 — so outdoor things go in the morning. Each meal has two options: pick by mood. Most lunches are walk-in; only the ⭐ dinners need booking (Fore Street/Twelve, Scales, Izakaya Minato). Eat the cold-water stuff the DMV can't give you: oysters, day-boat scallops, whole-belly fried clams. This plan is a menu, not a schedule — hit the anchors and pivot.

days.label: Arrive · Saturday
days.title: Fly in, drop bags, first oysters

beats.text: Land 12:25, Uber to the Portland Regency (~15 min), drop bags. Arrival lunch nearby, both walk-in ~5 min away: Duckfat (duck-fat fries + panini) or Eventide (oysters + brown-butter lobster roll).
Wander the Old Port wharves and a stretch of the Eastern Promenade while it's light (dark by ~4:30).
Dinner, both walk-in / no reservation: Eventide (if you didn't lunch there) or Central Provisions (small plates — tuna crudo, fried oysters). Go early to beat the wait.

days.fuel: First coffee: Bard Coffee (Old Port) or Tandem.

days.label: Portland · Sunday
days.title: Bakeries, the museum, and the grande dame

beats.text: Bakery breakfast at Tandem Coffee + Bakery (cardamom bun) or Standard Baking Co. (croissants). Walk the Western Prom for the Victorian mansions.
Lunch: Gilbert's Chowder House (whole-belly fried clams + chowder, walk-in) or ⭐ Chaval (West End, Spanish-French, veg-friendly — Resy) for a sit-down.
Portland Museum of Art (open Sun; closed Mon) — the Homer & Wyeth rooms. ~2 hrs.
Nice dinner — ⭐ Fore Street (rustic wood-fire; roasted mussels, turnspit roast; book forestreet.biz) or ⭐ Twelve (refined, modern; Resy). Walk-in fallback: Central Provisions.

days.fuel: Afternoon coffee: Speckled Ax (wood-roasted) on Congress St.

days.label: Cape Elizabeth · Monday
days.title: Lighthouse morning, harbor afternoon

beats.text: Uber to Fort Williams Park / Portland Head Light (~15 min) for the morning light — cliff path and the Cape Elizabeth shoreline.
Lunch back in town (Monday-open, walk-in): Highroller Lobster (lobster grilled cheese, Exchange St) or Becky's Diner (waterfront classic).
Casco Bay Lines ferry round-trip toward Peaks Island for harbor views (runs year-round), or warm up café-hopping.
Dinner — ⭐ Scales (wharf seafood, day-boat scallops; Resy) or walk-in Eventide / Duckfat. (Central Provisions & Twelve are usually closed Mondays.)

days.fuel: Warm up after the lighthouse: coffee + a potato donut at The Holy Donut.

days.label: Portland · Tuesday
days.title: Your slow drift day

beats.text: The drift day. Late breakfast at Hot Suppa (corned-beef hash) or lighter at a café, then wander the West End and Old Port shops at no pace.
Lunch if you want it: The Honey Paw (pan-Asian noodles, next to Eventide, walk-in) or Luke's Lobster (Portland Pier). Both easy.
An Allagash tasting (short Uber; Austin Street & Definitive next door) or just café-hop.
East Bayside Asian night — ⭐ Izakaya Minato (cozy izakaya, 54 Washington Ave; reserve or go early) and/or Cong Tu Bot next door (modern Vietnamese, walk-in). Pasta alt: Leeward (Resy).

days.fuel: Afternoon tea/coffee: Tandem on Congress St, or Coffee By Design.

beats.text: Grab-and-go before the airport (PWM food is thin): a Standard Baking Co. pastry or a Holy Donut. Maybe a last Old Port loop.
Leave the hotel ~10:45, Uber to PWM (~15 min), fly PWM → BWI 12:45p. Carry-on only = a straight walk out.

reservations.name: BWI → PWM
reservations.notes: Nonstop, 10:55a–12:25p. Southwest. Book Choice fare (carry-on boarding + flexibility).

reservations.name: Portland Regency Hotel & Spa
reservations.notes: 4 nights. Old Port, fully walkable base. No car — skip parking.

reservations.name: Chaval — Sun lunch (optional)
reservations.notes: Resy. Sit-down West End lunch, veg-friendly. Walk-in alt: Gilbert's Chowder House.

reservations.name: Fore Street — Sun dinner (option A)
reservations.notes: Book via forestreet.biz — releases ~1 month out; holds walk-in tables. Rustic wood-fire. Book this OR Twelve.

reservations.name: Twelve — Sun dinner (option B)
reservations.notes: Resy. Refined/modern. Book this OR Fore Street. Walk-in fallback: Central Provisions.

reservations.name: Scales — Mon dinner
reservations.notes: Resy. Wharf seafood, day-boat scallops. Open Mondays. Walk-in alt: Eventide.

reservations.name: Izakaya Minato — Tue dinner
reservations.notes: Reserve if offered, else go early — tiny. Cong Tu Bot (57 Washington Ave, walk-in) next door is the alt. Confirm open day.

reservations.name: Portland Museum of Art
reservations.notes: Closed Mondays — do it Sunday. Homer/Wyeth collection.

reservations.name: Portland Head Light — Fort Williams Park
reservations.notes: Free; grounds open year-round. Rideshare ~15 min. Go in the morning (early sunset).

reservations.name: Casco Bay Lines — Peaks Island ferry (optional)
reservations.notes: Optional year-round harbor loop; ~$12–25/person round trip.

checklists.name: Book these early
items: Flights — roundtrip BWI⇄PWM nonstop, Southwest Choice fare
Sun dinner — Fore Street (forestreet.biz, ~1 mo out) OR Twelve (Resy)
Tue dinner — Izakaya Minato (reserve or go early)
Confirm day-of-week hours (several close Sun/Mon: Central Provisions, Twelve, Leeward, Minato, Cong Tu Bot)

checklists.name: Packing (carry-on only)
items: Warm layers + a real coat — Maine November runs 30s–50s°F
Waterproof shoes; light rain shell or umbrella
